categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label, modifies orphan handling and package evaluation logic in src/net_processing.cpp, and adds functional tests in test/functional/p2p_orphan_handling.py.
categories.rationale: Fixes an invalid debug assertion failure and cleans up orphan download state when a 1P1C orphan child is already in the mempool. As noted in the PR description, an orphan entering the mempool via non-peer pathways such as RPC remains in the orphanage, causing package evaluation to report MEMPOOL_ENTRY and trigger an Assume(false) assertion in debug builds.
